No finite numerical test is mistaken for a universal proof. The boundary has only a spectral imaginary pair, not a claimed nonlinear bifurcation.

originality.rationale: The published 2026 motivator proves only existence and sufficient small-relaxation stability; the inspected 2015 unperturbed-ring text gives qualitative Eckhaus stabilization without the exact five-site transition. The new claim is a complete parameter-and-winding classification at the smallest admissible network size, with a nontrivial quintic algebraic boundary and explicit crossing frequency. A prior 2007 general network-spectral analysis is a concrete uninspected risk; available statements did not provide an equivalent evaluated classification. Search absence is not proof of global novelty.
